title: Lie Algebra, Global Inversion, and the Case for Ontological Two-Sidedness
summary: The effectiveness of mathematics in describing nature has long invited philosophical explanation. This paper examines whether Lie algebra embodies organizational principles that extend beyond its traditional role in symmetry analysis. Beginning with the fundamental properties of Lie brackets, including antisymmetry, bilinearity, the Jacobi identity, and the derived relation [𝑋,−𝑋]=0, it is argued that Lie algebra provides a formal grammar of relational coherence. Particular attention is given to the invariance of Lie-algebraic structure under global reflection 𝑋↦−𝑋, which preserves brackets…

review.reason: Examines Lie algebra as a organizing principle and its role in describing nature.
